results.summary:
A real init() test, plus the offline seam the tarball half needed. PR #79 (draft), branch worktree-kb-78-1, commit 58e4f87.

Primary: test/init.test.js now drives the actual init() against a temp git repo with test/fake-gh.js installed as the transport inside src/gh.js (no gh, no network), through the real parseArgs + makeContext, with --repo acme/board so detectRepo never runs. It asserts the whole contract: the profile set on a fresh board (bare / --profiles / --harness) and a re-run that keeps a hand-added profile with the operator's edits; the exact 11 labels that reach the transport and that nothing else does; both hooks in .claude/settings.json plus a summary line naming both; every line of the shipped ignore list; the skill copied out of the package file for file with board.json stamped and the .claude/skills/kanban link; the CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md section spliced from templates/doc-section.md above pre-existing content; and a second init that leaves the footprint byte-identical with no duplicate hook, ignore line or section and no label churn. Verified the done-when: reintroducing #72 fails 3 tests, #73 fails 2, #74 fails 5, each under npm test.

Secondary (the seam, called out as the card asked): smoke-pack could only have run init as far as the API step, so init grows --no-labels. Labels are the only step that needs the network, so with --repo owner/name the command writes the whole local footprint and sends nothing — a real offline path for a machine where gh is not logged in yet. It is in the help and the README quickstart, it names what it skipped and what to run next, and it refuses --import/--project (exit 2) before writing anything rather than half-honouring them. scripts/smoke-pack.mjs runs it in a scratch repo from the installed tarball and compares what landed against the packaged originals (SKILL.md, references/protocol.md, doc-section.md) plus board.json, the .gitignore block and the two hooks. Checked the failure path by hand against a package root with templates/doc-section.md removed: exit 1, with the fix named.

Note for the next worker: src/init.js is covered by no wiki page (wiki-coverage: 10 of 21 in-scope src files uncovered, no init/adoption page in the plan), so --no-labels is documented in README/help only. The two existing pages went stale purely on the cli.js blob and were re-stamped with a log line.
